items.heading: Most Articles on This Topic
items.text: Most articles on this topic either sell the dream or list every possible upside without checking which ones are actually tied to leaving India. Neither approach helps you decide.

items.heading: The Clearest Way to Separate
items.text: The clearest way to separate marketing from reality is to sort common claims into two lists: what India can genuinely offer with effort, and what is actually hard to get without physically being in another country.
